name: token_conditioned_key_adapter_engineering_gate_amendment_2026-11-09
scope: Engineering-gate clarification only; the candidate method, data split, training schedule, validation release rule, and efficacy metrics are unchanged.

corrections.issue: The gate implementation required a source revision that was not recorded in the protocol.
corrections.resolution: Pin the official SAM2 source revision to 2b90b9f5ceec907a1c18123530e92e794ad901a4.

corrections.issue: The original gate checked native replay in the training-step path but did not require full autoregressive inference parity at zero adapter initialization.
corrections.resolution: Require exact tensor equality for native and zero-adapter full propagation outputs on the frozen seq2 and seq3 clips.

corrections.issue: The verifier required a nonzero learned-key-change receipt that the adapter did not emit.
corrections.resolution: Record per-read key residual L1 and nonzero-element counts, and require zero values at initialization and finite nonzero values after adapter updates.

corrections.issue: Resume replay compared optimizer-state keys but not optimizer values or post-update RNG state.
corrections.resolution: Compare the complete optimizer state and post-update RNG tensor for exact resumed-update replay.

unchanged: Model design and trainable parameter set
PolypGen train, validation, test, and excluded sequences
Validation release rule and efficacy endpoints
No test inference before the frozen validation rule passes
